subject: maths
question_text: The following graph shows the temperature of a patient in a hospital, recorded every hour.

question_image.description: Graph showing the temperature of a patient recorded every hour.

parts.part_text: What was the patient's temperature at 1 p.m.?
parts.answer_text: At 1 p.m., the patient's temperature was 36.5°C.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the patient's temperature at 1 p.m. was 36.5°C.

parts.part_text: When was the patient's temperature 38.5°C?
parts.answer_text: The patient's temperature was 38.5°C at 12 noon.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the temperature reached 38.5°C at 12 noon.

parts.part_text: The patient's temperature was the same two times during the period given. What were these two times?
parts.answer_text: The patient's temperature was the same at 1 p.m. and 2 p.m.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the two times were 1 p.m. and 2 p.m.

parts.part_text: What was the temperature at 1.30 p.m? How did you arrive at your answer?
parts.answer_text: The temperature at 1:30 p.m. is 36.5°C, as the graph between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m. is parallel to the x-axis.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the temperature at 1:30 p.m. was 36.5°C.

parts.part_text: During which periods did the patient's temperature show an upward trend?
parts.answer_text: During the following periods, the patient's temperature showed an upward trend: 9 a.m. to 10 a.m., 10 a.m. to 11 a.m., and 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the upward trends were observed during those specified periods.

difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of graph interpretation and basic reasoning.

question_images.description: Graph showing the temperature of a patient recorded every hour.

subject: maths
question_text: The following line graph shows the yearly sales figure for a manufacturing company.

parts.part_text: What were the sales in (i) 2002 (ii) 2006?
parts.answer_text: In 2002, the sales were Rs 4 crores and in 2006, the sales were Rs 8 crores.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the sales figures were Rs 4 crores in 2002 and Rs 8 crores in 2006.

parts.part_text: What were the sales in (i) 2003 (ii) 2005?
parts.answer_text: In 2003, the sales were Rs 7 crores and in 2005, the sales were Rs 10 crores.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the sales figures were Rs 7 crores in 2003 and Rs 10 crores in 2005.

parts.part_text: Compute the difference between the sales in 2002 and 2006.
parts.answer_text: The difference between the sales in 2002 and 2006 is Rs 4 crores.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the difference in sales is Rs 4 crores.

parts.part_text: In which year was there the greatest difference between the sales as compared to its previous year?
parts.answer_text: The greatest difference in sales was in the year 2005 as compared to its previous year 2004.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the greatest difference was observed in 2005.

answer_image.description: Line graph showing yearly sales figures for a manufacturing company.

difficulty_reasoning: Involves basic calculations and understanding of sales data.

question_text: Were the two plants of the same height during any week shown here? Specify.

parts.part_text: (i) After 2 weeks, the height of plant A was 7 cm.
parts.answer_text: After 2 weeks, plant A was 7 cm tall.

parts.part_text: (ii) After 3 weeks, the height of plant A was 9 cm.
parts.answer_text: After 3 weeks, plant A was 9 cm tall.

parts.part_text: (i) After 2 weeks, the height of plant B was 7 cm.
parts.answer_text: After 2 weeks, plant B was also 7 cm tall.

parts.part_text: (ii) After 3 weeks, the height of plant B was 10 cm.
parts.answer_text: After 3 weeks, plant B was 10 cm tall.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant A during 3rd week = 9 cm - 7 cm = 2 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant A during the 3rd week was 2 cm.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant B from the end of the 2nd week to the end of the 3rd week = 10 cm - 7 cm = 3 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant B during this period was 3 cm.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant A during 1st week = 2 cm - 0 cm = 2 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant A during the 1st week was 2 cm.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant A during 2nd week = 7 cm - 2 cm = 5 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant A during the 2nd week was 5 cm.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant A during 3rd week = 9 cm - 7 cm = 2 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant A during the 3rd week was 2 cm.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, plant A grew the most, i.e. 5 cm, during the 2nd week.

parts.part_text: Growth of plant B during 1st week = 1 cm - 0 cm = 1 cm
parts.answer_text: The growth of plant B during the 1st week was 1 cm.

question_text:
A courier-person cycles from a town to a neighboring suburban area to deliver a parcel to a merchant. His distance from the town at different times is shown by the following graph.
(a) What is the scale taken for the time axis?
(b) How much time did the person take for the travel?
(c) How far is the place of the merchant from the town?
(d) Did the person stop on his way? Explain.
(e) During which period did he ride fastest?

mcq_options.option_text: What is the scale taken for the time axis?
How much time did the person take for the travel?
How far is the place of the merchant from the town?

Did the person stop on his way? Explain.
(e) During which period did he ride fastest?

question_image.description: Graph showing the distance of the courier-person from the town over time.

parts.part_text: What is the scale taken for the time axis?
parts.answer_text: Scale taken for the time axis is 4 units = 1 hour.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the scale for the time axis is 4 units equals 1 hour.

parts.part_text: How much time did the person take for the travel?
parts.answer_text: The person travelled during the time 8 a.m. - 11:30 a.m.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the person took 3.5 hours to travel.

parts.part_text: How far is the place of the merchant from the town?
parts.answer_text: The merchant is 22 km far from the town.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, the distance to the merchant is 22 km.

parts.part_text: Did the person stop on his way? Explain.
parts.answer_text: Yes, the person stopped on his way from 10 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. This is indicated by the horizontal part of the graph.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the person did stop during the journey.

parts.part_text: During which period did he ride fastest?
parts.answer_text: From the graph, it can be observed that during 8 a.m. to 9 a.m., the person travelled the maximum distance.
parts.final_answer: Thus, the person's ride was the fastest between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m.

difficulty_reasoning: Requires interpretation of a graph and understanding of distance-time relationships.
